svg.title: A paused run resumes after peer instruction
svg.desc: Reuse the paused route and extend it toward the worker after the peer card arrives. Keep the unauthenticated marker visible at the crossing so influence cannot read as authorization. Pin the task to its resumed state; the object silhouette persists while its status changes.
